question: What claim about the speaker's intention is at stake in promising to tell the beloved the arrangement of the rows of yoginīs?
premises: The arrangement of the rows of yoginīs is a defined subject.
The speaker promises to tell it.
The promise is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The speaker intends to disclose the arrangement of the rows of yoginīs to the beloved.
plain_english: O beloved, I shall tell you the arrangement of the rows of yoginīs.
